_note: Fill test, 2026-09-09. The operator's rule: the image must COVER the disc and stop at it. `inscribe` cannot satisfy that by construction, so both framed cards move to `cover`. The X-ray uses the film cropped out of the photo OF the film. The CO card is the open question - its source is a white product shot on white, so on a light ground a cover-crop may leave the disc invisible; both grounds are here to find out. `circle_floor` is lowered where the subject is a rectangle of image data with no silhouette: a radiograph loses its ends to a round window the way any cropped photograph does, which is not the cut-off-object failure the 0.9 floor exists to catch.
